plan-for-submitting-a-bundle.text: Issue 640. One pull request, three slices of at most 90 minutes each.

decisions.text: Witnesses come as repeatable --witnesses FILE; a directory expands to its .witness files.

slices.text: Provider read and assembly export, with unit specs.

gate.text: Existing hosted commands, each as its step runs it. In offchain/: the focused suite with the submit and provider selections; the end-to-end lane for node, boot, insert and config; lint; the component build; the export-freeze check. At the root, inside the development shell: the repository lint, the effect-site inventory, the narration check; the documented-flags check and its controls; the wallet vault controls; the build graph check. Every run goes through a memory-capped, time-bounded scope with stdin closed.
